I replied to Pree in a thread on her correction in #central-team: "Thanks for the correction, Pree. Updated: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47, not Dock 23 as in this morning's post."

Gate 47 now replaces Dock 23. She said no action was needed, so I didn't change any files, calendars or mail. My earlier thread reply that says Dock 23 is still there; I didn't edit or delete it.
